name: Yokubari Saboten
source:
After years of separation, Fujimiya Tomoya is united with friends and family from his past, yet things are not the same as before. Tomoya has grown to become a handsome individual, and the girls he remembers as merely cute have blossomed into beautiful examples of womanly perfection. As they all explore their new feelings, hearts and emotions will race, making their once simple relationships more complex than they could ever imagine.

Yokubari Saboten is an adult oriented comedy game published by Alicesoft in early 2006.

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064653/http://www.elizar.com/?p=43]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
